summary: The Water4All 2025 Joint Transnational Call supports international research and innovation projects addressing challenges at the interface between water and human health, focusing on innovative water tools and technologies for water quality monitoring, treatment, remediation, disinfection, and behavior/effects of contaminants including emerging contaminants and plastics.
eligible_applicants: Public and private entities eligible in participating countries
activity_types: Two-stage proposal submissions (pre-proposals and full proposals)
reporting_requirements: Project progress and financial reporting as per host funding body guidelines
Compliance with Water4All partnership reporting and dissemination requirements
